description: Explicit public-site source inventory. New paths require a reviewed entry; directory membership alone never grants publication. Runtime provenance/acceptance is separate.

runtime.purpose: Portable CSS, tokens, fonts, assets, component/runtime source and browser imports used by the public design system.

authoring.purpose: Published templates, specimen pages, UI kits and consumer examples; capability support still requires the documented toolchain.

documentation.purpose: Public entrance documents, EN/VI operator guides, licensing notices and the documentation reader.

diagnostics.purpose: Public browser audit harnesses and their explicitly selected source/data/baseline dependencies; not private task or acceptance records.

_audit/ci/pixel-diff-report.json.purpose: Optional last pixel comparison report; absence must remain visible, not a passing quality claim.
